hook.line: If you haven't heard, Google is completely changing how Search will work.
hook.visual: Desk-chair talking head in a purple neon room; a reply-to-comment sticker asks for a good Google alternative; bold white word captions mid-frame.

beats.what: News hook over a reply-to-comment sticker asking for a Google alternative
Cut: list promise, three options and she uses the third
Number one DuckDuckGo, its logo pops up over her chest
Cut: AI features can be switched off, AI images hidden
Cut: DuckDuckGo is on PC, iOS and Android
Cut: number two Brave, own independent index
Cut: number three Ecosia, the one she switched to, a non-profit planting trees
Asks which search engine viewers are switching to

why_it_works: Reply-to-comment sticker frames the video as an answer to a real viewer question
Timely news (Google prioritising AI answers) gives an urgent reason to watch
'I use the third one' holds viewers to the end of the list
Closing question invites people to name their own pick in the comments
weaknesses: 111 s with almost no graphics after the first logo; long stretches of the same framing
Hedges ('please let me know if I'm wrong', 'if I'm not mistaken') weaken authority
Option numbers are only spoken, never shown, so the list structure is hard to follow muted
for_robert: Answer a viewer comment with the reply sticker on screen, and tease which option you use so people stay; show numbers on screen, which she skips.
